verdict.rationale: Expensify's Integration Server API supports server-to-server automation with partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret credentials. Per the docs, it can programmatically download report data and provision accounts, which gives a headless, non-UI way to drive the product from scripts or CI. There is no official CLI, CI integration, or documented pipeline workflow, and the GitHub repo evidence covers building the app itself rather than running the product headlessly. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples, breadth of API operations beyond report export and provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
